create.name: Andy Hobson
create.bio:
Andy Hobson is a meditation teacher and composer based in Newbury, West Berkshire. In his twenties he drummed in a band that signed to a major label in 2003 and toured widely, and when that ended a few years later he turned to Buddhist teachings, books and daily sitting practice. He began leading small meditation groups in London in 2010, writing his own music to sit beneath the recordings he made for students. His training includes the first level of mindfulness teacher training at Bangor University, counselling skills, arts-based work with children, the Mindfulness in Schools primary programme and a sound practitioner course with Tibetan and crystal bowls. For several years he ran a children's support service at a London primary school.

His teaching is warm, informal and often funny, and does not follow one tradition. He blends guided practice with storytelling and original soundtracks, and his audio courses include a ten-day seasonal journey set in an imagined land, a thirty-day beginners' course and meditations for children. His book Doorways To Being mixes stories, practices and reflections. Around Newbury he leads sound baths with bowls, chimes, flute and guitar, and works with local schools, while one-to-one mentoring runs over Zoom. He also teaches on The Mindfulness App and releases music as Coraland.

books.title: Doorways To Being: A transformative journey of self-discovery, healing and new beginnings
books.author: Andy Hobson
books.description: A collection of short stories, guided practices and prompts for reflection, written in Andy's light and personal voice. It invites readers to accept themselves as they are and to find more meaning and ease in ordinary life.

courses.title: One-to-One Mentoring
courses.description: Hour-long mentoring sessions over Zoom for people who feel stuck or sense that a change is coming. Andy keeps a small client list and starts with a free 15-minute call to see whether the fit is right.

courses.title: Immersive Sound Baths
courses.description: A 75-minute session that opens with a guided relaxation, then moves into crystal and Tibetan bowls, chimes, Native American flute, acoustic guitar and ambient electronic sound. There is time to talk at the end; bring a mat, blanket and pillow.

courses.title: Whispers Beneath An Ancient Sun: An Enchanted Journey Through The Seasons Within
courses.description: A ten-day Insight Timer course that sets each practice inside a story, moving through winter, spring, summer and autumn with a cast of wizards and a griffin. Themes include meeting fear, presence, joy and letting go.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Doorways To Being: Healing Practices For Everyday Life
courses.description: A thirty-day Insight Timer course of talks and meditations on self-acceptance and fresh starts, set to Andy's own music. It is the audio companion to his book of the same name.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Beginner's Guide To A Mindful Life
courses.description: A thirty-day audio course for newcomers, with more than six hours of lessons and practices that build a daily meditation habit step by step. The music is composed and played by Andy.

courses.title: Everyday Meditations
courses.description: An album of guided meditations shaped around a working day, from a morning practice and a walking meditation to one for the commute and one for arriving home. Over two hours of audio with Andy's own background music.

free_resources.title: Andy Hobson on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Hundreds of guided meditations, sound journeys and story-led practices set to Andy's own music, plus recordings of his live sessions. The single tracks are free to hear.

free_resources.title: Doorways To Being Handbook
free_resources.description: The illustrated PDF workbook that accompanies his thirty-day course, with reflections and practices for each day. It is a free download from his site.

free_resources.title: Peace on Earth (Free Meditation)
free_resources.description: A free guided meditation that imagines the first flowers appearing on Earth and invites you to chant OM and AH. Andy asks those who download it to consider giving to one of the charities he names.

flags: Tier total (~148k) is in the 80k–150k band and rests almost entirely on Insight Timer; Instagram count could not be read.
Email is Cloudflare-obfuscated in the site footer and was decoded (andy@andyhobsonmeditation.com).

Sound bath venue, dates and price are not shown (the dates block on the page is a broken shortcode); local base taken from Insight Timer (Newbury) and his West Berkshire schools page, so availability local_online.
His About page and IT courses mention his own past depression and anxiety, and the schools page is framed around children's mental health; none of that is in the plan.
Several YouTube titles carry recording dates (sound baths, live sessions); they are recordings, not events, so kept as they are.
Insight Timer bio could only be partly quoted by WebFetch; bio check relied mainly on his own site pages.
The @andyhobson YouTube handle (3 subscribers) is someone else; his channel is @AndyHobson1.
